TECHNOLOGY FOR EVERYDAY LEGAL WORK

Technical support for people who work with legal cases.

A signing app that will not open, an unrecognized certificate or a disconnected printer can interrupt your firm's work. We assess your computer setup and guide you through the necessary adjustments.

PJe and PJeOffice setup

Checking the signing application's installation, browser communication and components required by your electronic court system.

Digital certificates and tokens

Help installing and configuring A1 certificates or token and card-reader drivers for A3 certificates, subject to hardware compatibility.

Browser and court portal access

Analysis of browser settings, permissions and access errors. Tell us whether you use PJe, eproc or another portal so we can assess your situation.

PDF, scanning and printing

PDF software setup, document scanning, printer drivers and print settings that can be adjusted remotely.

Email and office tools

Email account setup, installation of licensed software and guidance on organizing and backing up work files.

Slow computer or low storage

Checking storage, temporary files and startup programs to identify what is affecting performance.

QUESTIONS FROM LEGAL PROFESSIONALS

PJe, digital signing and remote access.

PJe does not recognize my certificate. Can you help?

We can assess the certificate installation, drivers, token or reader and signing environment. Tell us the error message and system you use so we can check available support.

Do you issue or renew digital certificates?

The service described here is technical support for configuration and use. Issuing or renewing certificates must be handled by the relevant certification authority.

Do you access case files and submit court filings?

This is technical support for your computer and software. Accessing cases, checking documents, signing and submitting court filings remain the lawyer's responsibility.

Can everything be resolved before a court deadline?

Timing and resolution depend on the diagnosis, availability and external systems. Explain the urgency when you first contact us; resolution before a deadline cannot be guaranteed.

How do quotes for lawyer support work?

Send a description of the issue, court and system on WhatsApp. We assess whether remote support is suitable and agree on the price and appointment before starting.
